description: Send (or resend) the email-verification link for the authenticated account's address. The address is always the one on the account, never caller-supplied. Idempotent on an already-verified account.

alreadyVerified.description: True when the account's email was already verified and nothing was sent.

note.description: Present when the server has no email transport configured and the link was logged to the server console instead.

errors.name: AccountNotFound
errors.description: The authenticated account no longer exists.

errors.name: VerificationDisabled
errors.description: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_POLICY is off on this server.

errors.name: EmailDeliveryFailed
errors.description: The verification email could not be sent. Try again later.
